units.source_text: 后来我进行了机械式的作业。

en.t: After that, I carried out the work mechanically.

units.source_text: 我把摞在大书院后门口的行李分四次搬到金阁的义满像前。

en.t: I carried the luggage piled by the rear entrance of the Great Hall to the front of the Yoshimitsu statue in the Golden Pavilion in four trips.

units.source_text: 首先搬的，是拆去吊钩的蚊帐和一床褥子。

en.t: The first things I carried were the mosquito net with its hanging hooks removed and one mattress.

units.source_text: 其次是皮箱和柳条箱，再其次是三招稻草。

en.t: then a leather suitcase and a wicker trunk, and after that three bundles of straw.

units.source_text: 我把这些东西胡乱地摞在一起，将三捆稻草夹在蚊帐和棉被之间。

en.t: I piled these things together at random, wedging the three bundles of straw between the mosquito net and the cotton quilts.

units.source_text: 蚊帐最易引火，我把它半摊开盖在其他行李上。

en.t: The mosquito net would catch fire most easily, so I spread it half open over the other luggage.
